formula: abs(a-b) <= 1e-7*max(abs(a),abs(b)) + 1e-10*max(abs(all four coefficients of both variants at this point))
input_policy: Byte-identical retained physics cards and all100 point stream
status_policy: All rows require stable own Ninja DP/QP statuses; preserve and report every accuracy/status change. Added rescues require investigation; never loosen stability thresholds.
campaign: Independent confirmatory series following the sealed inconclusive7 pairs. No sample exclusion, no stopping rule based on observed ratios, no further adaptive rerun without a source change. Primary result is these21 pairs alone; any combined28-pair analysis is explicitly secondary.
